title: Causal Prompting: Debiasing Large Language Model Prompting based on Front-Door Adjustment

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model robustness by comparing performance on standard in-distribution datasets against adversarial out-of-distribution (OOD) datasets. These adversarial datasets are generated by modifying text spans, reversing target/non-target sentiments, adding meaningless sentences, or swapping antonyms to test the model's reliance on irrelevant prompt context rather than true causal reasoning.
